name: maga
description: Make Apps Great Again through one product-facing Codex lead with on-demand professional workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Make Apps Great Again through one product lead.
interface.longDescription: Make Apps Great Again. Start with one pinned product lead, then open specifically named research, prototype, diagnosis, review, delivery, or release tasks with responsibility-level model and reasoning defaults. MAGA registers eighteen focused Skills, automatically re-pitches explanations that did not land, routes human-readable local-file text through Humanization, protects Git history and commit-based releases, keeps product workflow methods internal, and preserves Ponytail lifecycle behavior.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this product idea into a working first version.
Configure the model and reasoning depth for each MAGA responsibility.
Continue this project from its current state.
